title: mri_normalize
description: Normalize the white-matter, optionally based on control points. The input volume is converted into a new volume where white matter image values all range around 110.

nonmax_suppress.description: Turn non-maximum suppression on (1) or off (0) when using interior of surfaces
nonmax_suppress.title: Non-Maximum Suppression

conform.description: Interpolate and embed volume to be 256^3
conform.title: Conform Volume

lonly_labels.description: Use only control points in label file
lonly_labels.title: Only Use Labels

labels.description: Use control points in label file
labels.title: Label File

write_volumes.description: Write control point (c) and bias field (b) volumes
write_volumes.title: Write Control Point and Bias Field Volumes

intensity_above.description: Use control point with intensity above target (default=25.0)
intensity_above.title: Control Point Intensity Above

intensity_below.description: Use control point with intensity below target (default=10.0)
intensity_below.title: Control Point Intensity Below

prune.description: Turn pruning of control points on/off (default=off)
prune.title: Prune Control Points

no_gentle_cp.description: Do not use gentle normalization with control points file
no_gentle_cp.title: No Gentle Control Points

atlas_transform.description: Use atlas to exclude control points from being in non-brain regions
atlas_transform.title: Atlas Transform

sigma_smooth.description: Smooth bias field with given sigma
sigma_smooth.title: Sigma Smooth

renorm_vol.description: Load volume and use all points in it that are exactly 110 as control points
renorm_vol.title: Renormalization Volume

checknorm_vol.description: Load volume and remove all control points that aren't in [min max]
checknorm_vol.title: Check Normalization

load_read_cp.description: For reading control points and bias field
load_read_cp.title: Read Control Points

cp_output_vol.description: Output final control points as a volume (only with -aseg)
cp_output_vol.title: Control Points Output Volume

surface_transform.description: Normalize based on the skeleton of the interior of the transformed surface
surface_transform.title: Surface and Transform

seed_value.description: Set random number generator to seed N
seed_value.title: Random Seed Value
